Heheh!
It's another gorgeous morning, isn't it!

...Entering a debut selection race that will shape her future means
I'll soon get to see Mejiro Ryan running all-out with her well-honed body.

That joy of feeling the heat gradually spreading through a well-trained body
is something you just can't find anywhere else.

That's our Ryan-chan, quick on the uptake♪
Well then, I'll go on ahead and wait for ya!

Your debut selection race is coming up real soon, right?
It's time to put the finishing touches on training, so I figured we could run together!

Huh, late?
...Wait, aaaaah! Is that the time already!?
Um, would you like to come along with me right now!?

Still, the more you work out, the more your body gets toned,
and if you keep putting in the effort, it'll pay off eventually!
Yes! I think this is the best way I can thank you!!

Oh, right! I was planning to try out a new running routine!
Alright, one more lap... no, five more laps...!

Whoa-whoa-whoa...!!
It's such a gorgeous morning that I completely lost track of time!!
One morning, while taking a stroll along the riverbank—

Ryan-chaaan?
...Ah, I knew you'd be here!
Catch ya later!!

Whoa, really!? Awesome!!
Let's get changed and jump right into it!!

Feels like I could run laps around here all day.
Enjoy your walk! Catch ya later!

I've just always loved exercising ever since I was a kid.
To be honest, that's pretty much my only strong point, but...

Thanks so much for this morning!
Thanks to you, I wasn't late for school... You really saved me!

Mejiro Ryan said with a refreshing smile before sprinting off.
She was only jogging lightly, but her steady, powerful form was utterly captivating.

Alright Trainer, thanks for all your hard work today!
I'll be taking off now.

Looking good! You've got great form!
Let's keep this momentum going right into the second half!!

That feeling when you cross the finish line faster than anyone else,
before anyone else—
...However, looking at the time, she really ought to be getting ready for school. Is she going to make it?
I left the gym, quietly looking forward to seeing that day come.

Because of that, I can teach you all about how fun exercising can be!
I can even design a workout routine tailored specifically to your muscles!

A pleasant wave of fatigue washes over my body. The routine she guided me through
was a genuinely high-level workout...!
Let's do some muscle training together!

Wait... um, was that too sudden?
Maybe this isn't much of a thank-you after all...

Hup, hup...
Ah, oh-oh-oh!

Today's workout was tailored for you, Trainer,
so normally... I do about three times as much.

I'd love to thank you somehow, hmm...
Ah, I know!!

Something about Mejiro Ryan seemed a bit off, but
before I could ask her about it, another girl came running over.

Mejiro Ryan sped away from the spot,
putting on yet another display of her magnificent running form...

Whoa!?
Wait, what was with that girl just now...?

Looking closely at that badge on your collar...
Oh! You're a Trainer at the academy, aren't you!

THREEEEEEE!!
...All right, awesome job today!!

All right, let's get you moving to your heart's content!!
Did you drink enough water? Okay then, let's muscle!!

Shaving even a second off my time makes me so happy...
And the moment you produce real results in a race is even more special.
Huh? You're the person from this morning...!
Oh, Ines! What's up?
Yes!!

Sorry, gotta blast!
Thanks a million again—!!

Fantastic! Way to go! Your body is totally loving this!
Can you hear it? The joyful roar of your pectoral muscles!!

Oh, sweet! In that case, count me in!
Alright, let's head over right away!!

Seeing my hesitation, Mejiro Ryan looks visibly dejected.
It'd be far too heartbreaking to leave her hanging like this...
...Well, if you really boil it down, that's pretty much all there is to it.

Looks tough, but hang in there!
Everything we've done so far has awakened all your dormant muscles!!
Ooooone!
Hah, hah... Huh!?

Alright, here we are!!
Now then, as thanks for this morning—

Alright, this is really, truly the final rep!!
Trainer, let's count it out together as loud as we can!!

Phew...! Trainer, how's it feeling!?
Are you experiencing the wonders of muscle training with your whole body!?

One more! Just one more! ...Hit your limit?
Then let's finish with one last rep! ...And that's a wrap! Great workout!!
After school on that same day—
